newsitem.title: USA: Illinois corn one pct harvested, behind 6 average.
newsitem.headline: Illinois corn one pct harvested, behind 6 average.

text.p: Illinois' corn crop was one percent harvested as of Sunday, trailing the five-year average of six percent, the Illinois Agricultural Statistics Service said in its weekly crop update.
Corn was 22 percent mature, behind 44 percent average maturity for this time of year. Corn was rated nine percent excellent, 40 good, 34 fair, 12 poor and five very poor.

Light, scattered rains aided soybeans in the pod fill stage but more moisture was needed. Soybeans were less than one percent harvested as of Sunday, against the five-year average of four percent. Nine percent of the crop was dropping leaves, compared with 36 percent average. Soybeans were rated four percent excellent, 31 percent good, 41 percent fair, 18 percent poor and six percent very poor.
Topsoil moisture was 17 percent very short, 48 percent short, 35 percent adequate and nil surplus, the report said.
Pasture and range were rated two percent excellent, 19 percent good, 38 percent fair, 28 percent poor and 13 percent very poor.
